# Explore the Data a bit

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- haven::read_dta("../../data/processed/final_data.dta")
```


## Commodity index by Status

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(status != "EIT") %>%
  group_by(status, year) %>%
  reframe(
    mean = median(rnd_gdp, na.rm = T),
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean, color = status)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Commodity Index by Status") 
```
```{r}
df %>%
  select(commodity_index) %>%
  reframe(
    mean = mean(commodity_index, na.rm = T),
    median = median(commodity_index, na.rm = T),
    min = min(commodity_index, na.rm = T),
    max = max(commodity_index, na.rm = T)
  )
```

Top and Bottom 10
```{r}
df %>%
  select(ISO3, year, rnd_gdp) %>%
  filter(year==2010, !is.na(rnd_gdp)) %>%
  arrange(desc(rnd_gdp)) %>%
  slice(c(1:10, (n()-9):n())) %>%
  # bar plot
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ISO3, rnd_gdp), y = rnd_gdp)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Top and Bottom Commodity Index in 2010") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

```

Commodity Index by Region
```{r}
df %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2005, 2010, 2015, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(wesp_region = case_when(
    wesp_region == "North America" ~ "NAME",
    wesp_region == "Europe" ~ "EUR",
    wesp_region == "Developed Asia and the Pacific" ~ "DASIA",
    wesp_region == "Commonwealth of Independent States and Georgia" ~ "CIS",
    wesp_region == "Asia" ~ "ASIA",
    wesp_region == "Africa" ~ "AFR",
    wesp_region == "South-Eastern Europe" ~ "SEE",
    wesp_region == "Latin America and the Caribbean" ~ "LAC",
    TRUE ~ wesp_region
  )) %>%
  group_by(wesp_region, year) %>%
  reframe(
    mean = mean(commodity_index, na.rm = T),
  ) %>%
  # bar plot with years per region on x axis
  ggplot(aes(x = wesp_region, y = mean, fill = factor(year))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Commodity Index by Region and Year") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```



### Investment

summary statistics in 2010 about: inv_GDP, fdi_in_gdp, gross_CF_gdp, gross_fixed_CF_private_gdp

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(year == 2010) %>%
  select(inv_GDP, fdi_in_gdp, gross_CF_gdp, gross_fixed_CF_gdp, gross_fixed_CF_private_gdp, rnd_gdp) %>%
  skim() 
```

Histogram of Inv_GDP, gross_fixed_CF_gdp

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(year == 2010) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = inv_GDP)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(title = "Investment to GDP Ratio in 2010")
```
